exposure: Previous pregnancy loss at < 24 weeks gestation
cohort: 67,278 women, including 140 women aged ≥ 45 years at delivery
finding: Women aged ≥ 45 years have comparable pregnancy outcomes to those aged 40 to 44 years, although they have a higher prevalence of pre-existing maternal disease, which is associated with poorer outcomes.
mod_finding: Women ≥ 45 years were more likely to be delivered by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Reported, but not specified in the abstract
